## Summary

Describe the user-facing or engineering change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant smoke and acceptance checks
- [ ] No secrets, databases, manuscripts, generated assets, or installers added
- [ ] `docs/development-log.md` updated
- [ ] Author approval boundaries remain intact
